name: Bloopers
summary:
# Bloopers VR

**Race. Jump. Fall. Laugh. Repeat! 😂**

Welcome to BLOOPERS! You're a wobbly bean racing through crazy obstacle courses. Jump over gaps, dodge silly traps, and race your friends to the finish line!

**Up to 10 players. Tons of chaos. Endless laughs!**


# 🏆 RACE TO THE FINAL!

Can you survive all 3 rounds?

- **Round 1:** Race fast! Only half the players qualify.
- **Round 2:** Dodge obstacles and make it to the final!
- **Round 3:** Go for the win! Only one Blooper becomes the champion!
